title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Updated Red Hat OpenStack Platform 16.2 director Operator container images
description: Red Hat has released updated container images for the OpenStack Platform 16.2 director Operator to address multiple security vulnerabilities in the Go programming language components used. These include several denial of service issues, a cross-site scripting vulnerability, and a man-in-the-middle attack vector via untrusted intermediate certificates. The update mitigates these risks by providing patched container images for deployment within OpenShift Container Platform environments.
